GOLDEEN…

You know, I have
more fun fishing

than beating wild
#MON.

But a while back,
we came this close

to landing a wild
GOLDEEN.

I tell you, it was
huge. Believe me.

texts.answer:
KENJI here…

{PLAYER}! Beautiful
morning, hey?
texts.greet:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
This is KENJI!
chat:
I'm taking a break
on ROUTE 45!

Why not drop by if
you are free?

texts.answer:
Yup, yup!
It's PARRY!

Hah, and here's
{PLAYER}!
texts.greet:
{PLAYER}, it's
PARRY!

Have you had a
proper breakfast?
texts.generic:
Are your #MON
looking good?

My ONIX and
me--we're looking

mighty dandy!
Hahahah!
texts.wantsBattle:
You're thinking
you'd like to

battle me. Am I
right or what?

Yep! We'll meet on
ROUTE 45!
texts.hangUp:
OK, give me a call
again!
chat:
Yeah, we KO'd a
wild ONIX!

That was OK, but I
wanted to get it…

And yesterday, we
spotted a wild

ONIX.
We were debating

whether to catch
it or beat it.

When along came
another guy who

caught it!
How about that!

texts.answer:
Yes, this is
ERIN…

Oh. Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good morning!
texts.greet:
{PLAYER}!

It's ERIN!
Good morning!
texts.generic:
Are you raising
your #MON?

Hey, ERIN's
PONYTA is
looking good!
texts.wantsBattle:
I'm ERIN. Want to
battle me again?

I won't lose this
time!

I'll be waiting on
ROUTE 46!
chat:
And, and…
I just battled and
beat PONYTA!

I've raised my
#MON properly!

But, but…

A wild PONYTA

got away from me

again. It's just
not fair!

TrainerSchoolboyJack1.AskNumber1.text:
Your knowledge is
impressive!

I like that!

Want to trade
battle tips?

I'll phone if I
get good info.

Would you tell me
your number?

TrainerSchoolboyJack1.AskNumber2.text:
Want to trade
battle tips?

I'll phone if I
get good info.

Would you tell me
your number?

TrainerSchoolboyJack1.NumberAccepted.text:
I'll call you if I
hear anything!

TrainerSchoolboyJack1.NumberDeclined.text:
Oh, OK. Too bad…

Well, if you ever
want my number,
come see me, OK?

TrainerSchoolboyJack1.PhoneFull.text:
Oh?
Your phone's full.

It can't register
my number.

TrainerSchoolboyJack1.RematchStd.text:
Hi, I was waiting
for you to show!

Let's get started
right away!

TrainerPokefanfBeverly1.AskNumber1.text:
Your MARILL is so
cute and adorable!

You love #MON
just like I do!

Want to trade
phone numbers?

Let's chat! It'll
be so much fun!

TrainerPokefanfBeverly1.AskNumber2.text:
Your MARILL is so
cute and adorable!

We should chat, it
will be fun.

Can I have your
phone number?

TrainerPokefanfBeverly1.NumberAccepted.text:
To be honest, I
want a MARILL.

But I make do with
my cute SNUBBULL.

TrainerPokefanfBeverly1.PhoneFull.text:
Oh? Your phone's
memory is full.

TrainerPokefanfBeverly1.Gift.text:
Oh? {PLAYER}? 
I waited here for

you. I brought you
a little gift.

TrainerPokefanfBeverly1.PackFull.text:
Oh?
You have no room.

Please come back
for it later.

TrainerSailorHuey.AskNumber1.text:
Cool! That's the
first time I've
lost in a while!

Hey, give me your
phone number.

You'd be fun to
battle, so I'll

call you when I
get stronger!

TrainerSailorHuey.AskNumber2.text:
Hey, give me your
phone number.

You'd be fun to
battle, so I'll

call you when I
get stronger!

TrainerSailorHuey.Rematch.text:
Hey! I'm tired of
waiting for you!

TrainerSailorHuey.PackFull.text:
Oh… Your PACK's
full. I'll give it
to you later.

TrainerSailorHuey.RematchGift.text:
Man! You're as
tough as ever!

I've battled you
over and over, but

{PLAYER}, I haven't
won once.

I bought tons of
items to toughen

up my #MON, but
to no avail…

Items alone aren't
the answer.

That must be what
it is…

Here, take this,
{PLAYER}.

I won't be needing
it anymore…

TrainerCooltrainermGaven3.AskNumber1.text:
Wow, you're tough.
I haven't battled

that seriously in
a long time.

Could I get your
phone number?

I'd like to battle
again when I heal

VICTREEBEL and the
rest of my team.

TrainerCooltrainermGaven3.AskNumber2.text:
Could I get your
phone number?

I'd like to battle
again when I heal

VICTREEBEL and the
rest of my team.

TrainerCooltrainermGaven3.NumberAccepted.text:
How should I beat
you? I'm tormented

by those thoughts
all the time…

TrainerCooltrainermGaven3.NumberDeclined.text:
OK… I understand…
But if you change

your mind, give me
a shout anytime.

TrainerCooltrainermGaven3.PhoneFull.text:
Your phone's
memory is full.

You can't register
my number.

TrainerCooltrainermGaven3.Rematch.text:
Hi! I've been
waiting for you!

This time, I'm
going to win!

TrainerCooltrainerfBeth1.AskNumber1.text:
It's been a while
since I lost…

You're very good
at battling.

We should battle
again sometime.

By challenging a
tough trainer like

you, I think I can
get better too.

So how about it?

Would you give me
your phone number?

TrainerCooltrainerfBeth1.AskNumber2.text:
By challenging a
tough trainer like

you, I think I can
get better too.

So how about it?

Would you give me
your phone number?

TrainerCooltrainerfBeth1.NumberDeclined.text:
That's too bad…

Let me know if you
change your mind.

TrainerCooltrainerfBeth1.PhoneFull.text:
Oh no. Your phone
is out of memory.

TrainerCooltrainerfBeth1.Rematch.text:
You sure kept me
waiting! Let's go!

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.AskNumber1.text:
If my FARFETCH\U2019D

sees anything

pretty, it goes
and gets it.

Do you like pretty
things?

I could share if
it gets some more.

What's your phone
number? I'll call.

Don't expect a
whole lot, OK?

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.AskNumber2.text:
Do you like pretty
things?

I could share if
FARFETCH'D goes
and gets more.

What's your phone
number? I'll call.

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.NumberAccepted.text:
I'll call you as
soon as I get
something pretty.

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.NumberDeclined.text:
You sure? Well,
tell me if you
change your mind.

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.PhoneFull.text:
Huh? Your phone
list is full.

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.Rematch.text:
Tweet! Tweeeet!

Kept me waiting!
Go, FARFETCH'D!

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.Gift.text:
Kept me waiting!
Look, this is it!

See? Isn't it some
kind of pretty?

TrainerBirdKeeperJose2.PackFull.text:
Huh? You don't
have anywhere to

put this. Better
come back for it.

TrainerCooltrainerfReena.AskNumber1.text:
Not bad…
It's something to

beat me, even by
an unlikely fluke…

I like you! Give
me your number!

You can be my
practice partner!

TrainerCooltrainerfReena.AskNumber2.text:
Give me your phone
number!

You are going to
be my practice
partner!

TrainerCooltrainerfReena.NumberAccepted.text:
Don't be too proud
about beating me!

It was a fluke!

TrainerCooltrainerfReena.NumberDeclined.text:
I don't believe
it! You're going
to regret this!

TrainerCooltrainerfReena.PhoneFull.text:
What? Your phone
list has no room!

TrainerCooltrainerfReena.Rematch.text:
What took you?
Start right away!

TrainerYoungsterJoey.AskNumber1.text:
Listen, can I get
your phone number?

I'll ring you for
some battles.

I'm a rookie too, 
so I think it'd be
a good motivator.

TrainerYoungsterJoey.AskNumber2.text:
Can I get your
phone number?

I don't want to
lose against you!

We have to battle
again, OK?

TrainerYoungsterJoey.NumberAccepted.text:
I'll ring you
whenever I get the
urge to battle!

TrainerYoungsterJoey.NumberDeclined.text:
Oh, all right…

But I won't lose
to you again!

TrainerYoungsterJoey.RematchStd.text:
I've been waiting!
Let's battle now!

TrainerYoungsterJoey.PackFull.text:
Hey, wait! Your
PACK is stuffed!

Well, we'll leave
it till next time.

TrainerYoungsterJoey.RematchGift.text:
And yet another
loss…

No doubt about
it--you're tough.

Being beaten this
often actually
feels good now!

Here, take this. 
Use it to get even

tougher. That will
toughen me up too!

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.AskPhoneNumberSTD.text:
You're awesome!
I like you!

I look for #MON
here every day.

When I'm in the
grass, I find all
kinds of BERRIES.

If you'd like,
I'll share some.

Could I get your
phone number?

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.AskAgainSTD.text:
When I'm in the
grass, I find all
kinds of BERRIES.

If you'd like,
I'll share some.

Could I get your
phone number?

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.AcceptedNumberSTD.text:
You'll hear from
me as soon as I

find anything that
you might like.

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.DeclinedNumberSTD.text:
Oh well. Don't be
shy if you want to
get my number.

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.PhoneFullSTD.text:
Your phone list
has no room for my
number.

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.RematchSTD.text:
I was waiting for
you. Let's battle!

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.ItemSTD.text:
Good to see you!
See? This is what

I found.
It's for you!

TrainerBugCatcherWade1.PackFullSTD.text:
Oops, your PACK's
full. Too bad.

You should come
back for it later.

TrainerFisherRalph1.AskNumber1.text:
Don't young people
fish anymore?

I've seen rare
#MON while I've
been fishing…

You young people
like that, right?

Want to trade
phone numbers?

I'll let you know
if I see anything.

TrainerFisherRalph1.AskNumber2.text:
Hm? So you do want
me to phone if I
see rare #MON?

TrainerFisherRalph1.NumberAccepted.text:
Yep, phone if I
see rare #MON.

Don't worry, I
won't forget!

TrainerFisherRalph1.NumberDeclined.text:
Oh…
My own kids won't

even give me their
phone numbers…

Is that how young
people are today?

TrainerFisherRalph1.PhoneFull.text:
Your phone's
memory is full.

It seems that
young people all
have #GEAR.

TrainerFisherRalph1.RematchStd.text:
Hey, kid!

No losing for me
this day!

TrainerPicnickerLiz1.AskNumber1.text:
Oh? You're on a
big journey to see
the sights? Neat!

Let's be friends!
Can I have your
phone number?

I want to hear
about everything
you've seen!

TrainerPicnickerLiz1.AskNumber2.text:
Let's be friends!
Can I have your
phone number?

I want to hear
about everything
you've seen!

TrainerPicnickerLiz1.NumberAccepted.text:
I'll telephone you
if I hear anything
interesting.

TrainerPicnickerLiz1.NumberDeclined.text:

my friend?

TrainerPicnickerLiz1.PhoneFull.text:
Wait! Your phone
list is filled up!

TrainerPicnickerLiz1.RematchStd.text:
You're late! Let's
get started now!

TrainerHikerAnthony.AskNumber1.text:
By the way, I'm a
HIKER, so I often

go to mountains
and caves.

I occasionally see
rare #MON.

I could call you
the next time I
see one.

Feel like swapping
phone numbers?

TrainerHikerAnthony.AskNumber2.text:
I could call you
when I see some
rare #MON.

Feel like swapping
phone numbers?

TrainerHikerAnthony.NumberAccepted.text:
Be patient. I'll
find some rare
#MON for you!

TrainerHikerAnthony.NumberDeclined.text:
You're cold. I may
as well head to
the mountains…

TrainerHikerAnthony.PhoneFull.text:
Your phone's full.

It can't register
my phone number.

TrainerHikerAnthony.RematchStd.text:
All righty, then!

My #MON and I
are raring to go!

TrainerCamperTodd1.AskNumber.text:
From here, I can
see GOLDENROD's

DEPT.STORE. They
have bargain sales

up on the rooftop
every so often.

Could I get your
phone number?

I'll call you when
they have a sale.

TrainerCamperTodd1.AskNumber2.text:
If you give me
your number, I'll

call you when they
have a sale.

TrainerCamperTodd1.NumberAccepted.text:
I check GOLDENROD
DEPT.STORE every

day, so I know
when there's a
sale.

TrainerCamperTodd1.NumberDeclined.text:
Anyway…

If you're short on
money, take down
my number.

I'll call you when
there's a sale.

TrainerCamperTodd1.PhoneFull.text:
Your phone doesn't
have enough memory
for more numbers.

TrainerCamperTodd1.RematchStd.text:
I waited for you!
I even cut back my

shopping to raise
my #MON better!

TrainerPicnickerGina1.AskNumber1.text:
Whenever I see a
strong trainer, I

want to be their
cheerleader.

When I'm on my
walk, I sometimes
pick up items.

If I get anything,
you can have it!

Want to give me
your number?

I'll call as soon
as I get anything.

TrainerPicnickerGina1.AskNumber2.text:
If I find an item,
you can have it!

Want to give me
your number?

TrainerPicnickerGina1.NumberAccepted.text:
I'll call as soon
as I get anything!

TrainerPicnickerGina1.NumberDeclined.text:

I'll still be
rooting for you!

TrainerPicnickerGina1.PhoneFull.text:

all filled up!

TrainerPicnickerGina1.RematchStd.text:

I've gotten a bit
better at this!

TrainerPicnickerGina1.Gift.text:

here!

I think this will
make you happy.

TrainerPicnickerGina1.PackFull.text:

completely full.

I'll have to hold
on to this.

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.AskNumber1.text:
Reading textbooks
is worthwhile
every so often.

When I'm reading
and walking, I
have to look down.

on the ground.

Next time I find
something, I'll
give it to you.

May I have your
phone number?

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.AskNumber2.text:
If I find some-
thing, it's yours.

So may I have your
phone number?

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.NumberAccepted.text:
I'll call you as
soon as I find

something. You can
count on it!

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.NumberDeclined.text:
Oh… I thought it
would be a good

break to call you
when I'm studying…

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.PhoneFull.text:
There's no room
for my number.

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.Rematch.text:
I waited around
for you!

I'm thoroughly
prepared today!

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.Gift.text:
This, this! This
is yours! Ta-da!

TrainerSchoolboyAlan1.PackFull.text:
Whoops!

You can't carry
any more items!

I'll hold it until
next time.

TrainerLassDana1.AskNumber1F.text:
You're really good
at #MON!

Boys give me items
after battles, but

sometimes they
give me too much.

Next time, I can
share some if you

want. Let me get
your phone number.

I'll share my
gifts with you.

Let me get your
phone number.

TrainerLassDana1.NumberAccepted.text:
Next time a boy
gives me something

after a battle,
I'll share some!

Does that make me
bad?

TrainerLassDana1.DeclinedPhoneNumber.text:
Aww, you don't
want anything?

But it's all for
free…

TrainerLassDana1.PhoneFull.text:
But your phone's
out of memory!

TrainerLassDana1.Rematch.text:
You're really
late!

I'm eager to get
going!

TrainerLassDana1.Gift.text:
Hi! Are you here
for your gift?

This should really
make your day!

TrainerLassDana1.PackFull.text:
Where are you
going to put this?

I'll keep it, so
come get it later!

TrainerSchoolboyChad1.AskPhoneNumber1.text:
Huh? Is that thing
a #DEX? Have
you met PROF.OAK?

becoming a #MON

researcher like
PROF.OAK.

your phone number?

about PROF.OAK.

be loads of fun!

TrainerSchoolboyChad1.AskPhoneNumber2.text:

be loads of fun!

TALK, right?

TrainerSchoolboyChad1.SaidNo.text:
Oh… I wish I had a
chance to meet
PROF.OAK…

TrainerSchoolboyChad1.PhoneFull.text:
Your phone list is
completely full!

TrainerSchoolboyChad1.Rematch.text:
I've been waiting!
Let's battle now!

furry! How cute!

Let's be friends!

phone number?

even like PIKACHU…

for you! Here, see

I'm certain your
PIKACHU will love
my gift too!

TrainerPokefanmDerek.PackFull.text:
Uh-oh, too bad.
You don't have any

room. Be sure to
get it later.

Hey, you're trying
to be the ultimate

trainer too? Then
we're comrades!

If I find any more
items by the

water, I'll give
you some.

Just give me your
phone number.

TrainerFisherTully.AskNumber2.text:
If I find any more
items by the

water, I'll give
you some.

phone number.

TrainerFisherTully.PhoneFull.text:

make room for me.

TrainerFisherTully.Rematch.text:

more than just

fishing since we
last met.

You're in for a
big surprise!

TrainerFisherTully.Gift.text:
Hey, there you
are!

Here's a gift, as
promised!

TrainerFisherTully.PackFull.text:
Your PACK's full?

Come back later--
that'll do it.

By the way, you're
a #MANIAC…

Yes, you are.

But your knowledge
is shallow still!

Do you know BILL?

#MANIAC.
I revere him.

so leave me your
phone number.

TrainerPokemaniacBrent.AskNumber2.text:
I'll teach you all
I know about BILL,

so leave me your
phone number.

TrainerPokemaniacBrent.NumberDeclined.text:

regret it…

to be more tidy!

TrainerPokemaniacBrent.Rematch.text:

Hi! You like
CLEFAIRY too?

cute, aren't they?

good friends!

your phone number!

CLEFAIRY!

TrainerPicnickerTiffany.AskNumber2.text:
I want to know
your phone number!

Let's talk about
CLEFAIRY!

TrainerPicnickerTiffany.NumberDeclined.text:

Look for me if you

want to talk about
CLEFAIRY.

TrainerPicnickerTiffany.PhoneFull.text:
